## Causes

A team-game counts under every cause combination that makes it match with the fewest
causes. "Explained by it": the combination holds without the stand-in's scrambles; "only
with the stand-in": it needs them; "another cause also matches": a different combination
of the same size matches too. The size columns are this repository's value minus the other
repository's, before any adjustment.

### Pre-2006 scrambles counted as dropbacks (`scramble_dropbacks`)

- There: dropback_expr counts a run play flagged qb_scramble as a dropback, so it is also a scrimmage snap; nflverse leaves qb_dropback at 0 on most scrambles before 2006.
- Here: A dropback and a scrimmage snap need qb_dropback, rush, qb_kneel or qb_spike; a pre-2006 scramble has none of them, so it is in no play-by-play count here.
- Adjustment: Set qb_dropback to 1 on the run plays that are scrambles, then re-aggregate. With the qb_scramble flag the scrambles are the flagged plays; this repository's play-by-play cache does not carry that flag, so the stand-in is nflverse's scramble coding (a rush attempt coded as a pass play: pass 1, rush 0, rush_attempt 1). An attribution that holds only with the stand-in's plays is provisional and fails the run.
- Team-games explained (alone or with another cause): 2525; games: 1266; seasons: 1999-2005, 2016-2017, 2020, 2023.

### Plays without a down counted as early downs (`null_downs`)

- Here: An early down needs down <= 2; a missing down is not an early down.
- Adjustment: Fill a missing down with 0, then re-aggregate.
